sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: All right, the report's up.
sentences.zh: 好了，报告出来了。

sentences.en: The report's up.
sentences.zh: 报告出来了。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Okay, Mike.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want you to start on page 215, factual results of the obstruction investigation.
sentences.zh: 我要你从第215页开始看，即妨碍调查的事实结果。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 就现在。

sentences.en: Here's what I want you to excerpt.
sentences.zh: 这是我要你摘录的内容。

sentences.en: I want you to start on page 4.
sentences.zh: 我要你从第4页开始。

sentences.en: Nick, I want you to start at the bottom of page 8.
sentences.zh: 尼克，我要你从第8页底部开始。

sentences.en: 448 pages, two years in the making.
sentences.zh: 448页，历时两年写就。

sentences.en: That's new.
sentences.zh: 这很新鲜。

sentences.en: We didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我们以前不知道这一点。

sentences.en: What we learned from the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 我们从穆勒报告中了解到的内容。

sentences.en: That quote is new.
sentences.zh: 那句话是新的。

sentences.en: Where you're from.
sentences.zh: 你来自哪里。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月19日，星期五。

sentences.en: Michael, can you hear us?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你能听到我们说话吗？

sentences.en: Hey, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 听到了。

sentences.en: We're on the end of it.
sentences.zh: 我们在最后关头。

sentences.en: Hey, guys.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计们。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: All right, Mike Schmidt, Mark Mazzetti.
sentences.zh: 好了，迈克·施密特，马克·马兹蒂。

sentences.en: It's 915 on Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 现在是周四晚上9点15分。

sentences.en: You've both now spent about 10 hours reading the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 你们俩现在都花了大约10个小时阅读穆勒报告。

sentences.en: Tell me about this thing.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲这份东西吧。

sentences.en: It's a breathtaking document.
sentences.zh: 这是一份令人叹为观止的文件。

sentences.en: It's over 400 pages of detailed insights and accounts of enormous issues we've been focused on over the past two years.
sentences.zh: 它有400多页，包含了详细的见解和记录，涉及我们在过去两年中一直关注的重大问题。

sentences.en: It's divided into essentially two halves, one for Russia, one for the president's actions in office.
sentences.zh: 它基本上分为两半，一半关于俄罗斯，一半关于总统在任期间的所作所为。

sentences.en: In other words, collusion and obstruction.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，勾结与妨碍司法。

sentences.en: Those are the two buckets.
sentences.zh: 这就是那两个方面。

sentences.en: The first half detailing the contact between Russians and Trump advisors isn't enormously revealing in the sense that we had already heard some weeks ago that there had not been a,
sentences.zh: 前半部分详细描述了俄罗斯人与特朗普顾问之间的接触，并没有带来多大新意，因为我们几周前就已经听说，

sentences.en: quote, criminal conspiracy found by Mueller.
sentences.zh: 用引用的话说，穆勒没有发现“犯罪阴谋”。

sentences.en: At the same time, there's an enormous amount of detail concluding that in the midst of this really historic effort by the Russians to sabotage the election,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，其中有大量的细节得出结论：在俄罗斯这场堪称历史性的破坏选举的行动中——

sentences.en: hacking and leaking of emails, social media manipulation, fake news, it says that the Trump campaign welcomed this.
sentences.zh: 黑客攻击、泄露电子邮件、社交媒体操纵、假新闻——报告称特朗普竞选团队对此表示欢迎。

sentences.en: They saw a real benefit of what the Russians were doing, even if at the end of the day there wasn't an active conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了俄罗斯人所做事情的切实利益，即使归根结底并没有一个积极的阴谋。

sentences.en: He's essentially saying that they were interested, they sought out information about emails, they wanted to know more about how they could get their hands on these messages,
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，他们很感兴趣，他们搜寻了关于电子邮件的信息，他们想更多地了解如何才能弄到这些邮件，

sentences.en: they welcomed all this, but they never crossed the line into breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 他们对这一切表示欢迎，但他们从未越界触犯法律。

sentences.en: Just because they sought out the fruits of the Russian hack doesn't mean that they were part of the crime.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他们搜寻俄罗斯黑客攻击的成果，并不意味着他们就是犯罪的一部分。

sentences.en: And just to be very clear, how is what you're describing collectively not collusion?
sentences.zh: 为了非常明确起见，你所描述的这些总体上怎么能不叫勾结呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think we need to be careful because the attorney general said that there was no collusion and the president said there was no collusion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们需要谨慎，因为总检察长说过没有勾结，总统也说过没有勾结。

sentences.en: But the Mueller report is more nuanced.
sentences.zh: 但穆勒报告更加微妙。

sentences.en: And the Mueller report says, you know, this collusion word doesn't really mean anything to us.
sentences.zh: 穆勒报告说，你知道，这个“勾结”这个词对我们来说其实没有意义。

sentences.en: There's no legal standard of collusion.
sentences.zh: 没有法律上的勾结标准。

sentences.en: So what we're going to look at is what is a crime and that is conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要看的是什么是犯罪，那就是阴谋。

sentences.en: And that's what we have to judge all of this voluminous evidence againSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们必须据此衡量所有这些大量证据的标准。

sentences.en: And they said that a conspiracy is two parties acting together in concert to break the law.
sentences.zh: 他们说，阴谋是指两方共同采取行动去触犯法律。

sentences.en: And what Mueller is very clear about is that there is, quote, insufficient evidence of a conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 穆勒非常明确的一点是，存在——引述他的话——“证据不足的阴谋”。

sentences.en: He is not saying there was nothing.
sentences.zh: 他并不是说一无所有。

sentences.en: He is not saying full exoneration, but he's saying there is insufficient evidence to meet the standard that he had established of a criminal conspiracy, breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 他不是说完全洗清罪名，但他是说证据不足，达不到他所确定的犯罪阴谋、触犯法律的标准。

sentences.en: And what would Mueller have needed to see for this to add up to conspiracy?
sentences.zh: 那么穆勒需要看到什么，才能让这一切构成阴谋呢？

sentences.en: That would have looked like a conversation between the Trump campaign and the Russians where the Trump campaign was saying, hey, guys,
sentences.zh: 那看起来就像是特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯人之间的一场对话，当时特朗普竞选团队在说，嘿，伙计们，

sentences.en: can you go break into the DNC and steal some emails so we can then get them out and embarrass the Democrats and help us politically during the campaign?
sentences.zh: 你们能去闯入民主党全国委员会偷一些电子邮件吗？这样我们就可以把它们放出来，让民主党人难堪，并在竞选期间在政治上帮助我们。

sentences.en: That would have gotten you down the conspiracy path.
sentences.zh: 那样的话，你就走上阴谋这条路了。

sentences.en: And they did not find that.
sentences.zh: 而他们并没有发现这一点。

sentences.en: OK, so let's talk about obstruction.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来谈谈妨碍司法。

sentences.en: Mike, last time we talked a couple of weeks back, Mueller had sent his report to Barr and Barr had sent a summary of that report to Congress in advance of this full report.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我们几周前最后一次谈话时，穆勒已经把他的报告送交了巴尔，而在完整报告发布之前，巴尔已经向国会发送了该报告的摘要。

sentences.en: And the most confusing thing about that summary was that Mueller had not made a call on whether the evidence added up to obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 关于那份摘要，最令人困惑的事情是，穆勒没有对证据是否构成妨碍司法公正做出定性。

sentences.en: And today we get to see what Mueller's explanation is for why he didn't make a determination on whether the president broke the law.
sentences.zh: 今天我们得以看到穆勒的解释，关于他为什么没有对总统是否违法做出裁决。

sentences.en: And it's not clear cut.
sentences.zh: 情况并不那么明确。

sentences.en: What it essentially is, is that the president under Justice Department policy cannot be indicted.
sentences.zh: 其实质是，根据司法部的政策，现任总统是不能被起诉的。

sentences.en: And because the president cannot be indicted, it's unfair to accuse him while he's in office of breaking the law because there's no way for him to go to court to defend himself.
sentences.zh: 正因为总统不能被起诉，所以在他在任期间指控他违法是不公平的，因为他没有途径上法庭为自己辩护。

sentences.en: So, dear American public, Mueller essentially says, I am not going to make a determination on that issue.
sentences.zh: 所以，亲爱的美国公众，穆勒基本上是说，我不会对这个问题做出裁决。

sentences.en: That could be made after the president leaves office.
sentences.zh: 这可以在总统卸任后做出。

sentences.en: But for now, that would be unfair.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，那样做是不公平的。

sentences.en: So, what I will do is I will lay out for you what I found, what the potential obstruction was, why it may be illegal.
sentences.zh: 所以，我要做的是，向你们摆出我所发现的情况，什么是潜在的妨碍司法，为什么它可能是违法的。

sentences.en: And after the president leaves office, the Justice Department could make a determination that he indeed broke the law and bring a case.
sentences.zh: 在总统卸任后，司法部可以做出裁决，认定他确实触犯了法律并提起诉讼。

sentences.en: And at the end of explaining why a determination was not made, Mueller says,
sentences.zh: 在解释为什么没有做出裁决的结尾处，穆勒说：

sentences.en: if we had confidence after a thorough investigation of the facts that the president clearly did not commit obstruction of justice, we would so state.
sentences.zh: 如果我们经过对事实的彻底调查后有信心认为总统明显没有实施妨碍司法公正的行为，我们会明确说明。

sentences.en: Based on the facts and the applicable legal standards, however, we are unable to reach that judgment.
sentences.zh: 然而，基于事实和适用的法律标准，我们无法得出这一判断。

sentences.en: So, Mueller's basically saying, if we felt comfortable that the president had done nothing wrong, we would tell you.
sentences.zh: 所以，穆勒基本上是在说，如果我们觉得总统没有做错任何事，我们会告诉你们的。

sentences.en: And we are not telling you that.
sentences.zh: 而我们并没有这样告诉你们。

sentences.en: Well, Mike, you mentioned the incidents that he was not going to use as a basis for charging the president because he felt he couldn't charge the president.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克，你提到了那些他不会用作指控总统基础的事件，因为他觉得自己无法起诉总统。

sentences.en: What were those that he laid out in the report?
sentences.zh: 他在报告中列出的那些事件是什么？

sentences.en: Well, there's about a dozen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大约有十来个。

sentences.en: And they follow in chronological order how Trump misled the public about his relationship with Russia, misled the public about his knowledge that Russia was behind the hacks.
sentences.zh: 它们按时间顺序列出了特朗普如何就他与俄罗斯的关系误导公众，如何就他知道俄罗斯是黑客幕后黑手一事误导公众。

sentences.en: And as the presidency goes on and Mueller's appointed in May of 2017, right after he takes office,
sentences.zh: 随着总统任期的推进，穆勒于2017年5月被任命，就在他上任后不久，

sentences.en: the president starts to sort of lose his grip as he tries to maintain control of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 当总统试图维持对调查的控制时，他开始有点失去掌控了。

sentences.en: He was intent on using his power as the head of the executive branch to protect himself and use the tools at his disposal, the people running the Justice Department, the FBI,
sentences.zh: 他一心想要利用自己作为行政部门首脑的权力来保护自己，并动用手头的工具——运营司法部的那些人、联邦调查局（FBI）、

sentences.en: the intelligence community to help protect him from this investigation.
sentences.zh: 情报界——来帮助他免受这项调查的波及。

sentences.en: And what are some examples of that specifics?
sentences.zh: 那么其中有哪些具体的例子呢？

sentences.en: Well, a lot of them are ones that we know well, the firing of James Comey, his efforts to get his attorney general, Jeff Sessions,
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中许多是我们熟知的，解雇詹姆斯·科米，他试图让他的总检察长杰夫·塞申斯

sentences.en: to unrecuse himself from the Russian investigation, essentially reassert his control over something that he has stepped aside from because he has a conflict of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 解除在俄罗斯调查中的回避身份，基本上是重新确立他对一项因利益冲突而被迫退居其后的事务的控制。

sentences.en: And when the president can't get that done, he basically tries to get rid of Sessions and install a loyalist atop the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 当总统无法做到这一点时，他基本上试图除掉塞申斯，并在司法部高层安插一个忠诚的人。

sentences.en: These are things that have been reported in the press.
sentences.zh: 这些都是媒体报道过的事情。

sentences.en: We get a fuller, richer picture of them,
sentences.zh: 我们从中获得了更完整、更丰富的画面，

sentences.en: and we really see what the president was saying behind closed doors and the immense pressure he was putting on people to try and use the system to protect himself from the system.
sentences.zh: 我们真正看到了总统在闭门会议上说的话，以及他给人们施加的巨大压力，企图利用这个体制来保护自己免受这个体制的伤害。

sentences.en: But then we learn about incidents that we knew little about, like how the president went completely outside of his administration and government to Corey Lewandowski,
sentences.zh: 但随后我们了解到了那些我们知之甚少的事件，比如总统如何完全绕过他的政府和行政机构，直接去找科里·莱万多夫斯基——

sentences.en: his first campaign manager.
sentences.zh: 他的第一任竞选经理。

sentences.en: And he leaned on Corey in the summer of 2017 to try and pressure Sessions, his attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他在2017年夏天向科里施压，试图对他的总检察长塞申斯施加压力。

sentences.en: So here's the president of the United States using someone who doesn't even work for him to get to Sessions and try and get Sessions out there publicly to help clear Trump's name.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里的美国总统竟然利用一个甚至不为他工作的人去接触塞申斯，试图让塞申斯公开站出来帮助洗清特朗普的名声。

sentences.en: It's just a remarkable way of using presidential power,
sentences.zh: 这真是动用总统权力的一种非凡方式，

sentences.en: which suggests that the president was meeting resistance within his own administration and therefore reached out to somebody who didn't even work for the government to try to get him to achieve this end.
sentences.zh: 这表明总统在自己的政府内部遇到了阻力，因此才去联系一个甚至不在政府工作的人，试图让他来达到这个目的。

sentences.en: I don't think many in the public will want to hold up the president's aides as heroes, and a lot of them are probably not.
sentences.zh: 我想公众中没有多少人会把总统的助手们奉为英雄，他们中的许多人可能也确实不是。

sentences.en: But there is a picture here of folks that stopped the president time and time again and thwarted him from doing things that may have actually gotten him into trouble,
sentences.zh: 但这里呈现出这样一幅画面：有一群人一次又一次地阻止了总统，阻挠他去做那些可能真的会给他惹上麻烦的事情，

sentences.en: that may have crossed that line, that may have made a stronger argument for Mueller about why the president did obstruct justice.
sentences.zh: 那些可能已经越过红线的事情，那些可能会让穆勒更有理由证明总统确实妨碍了司法公正的事情。

sentences.en: One of the most detailed ones is on Trump's efforts to get rid of Mueller and how his White House counsel would not do that.
sentences.zh: 其中最详细的一个事件是关于特朗普试图除掉穆勒，以及他的白宫法律顾问如何拒绝这样做。

sentences.en: He would not call the Justice Department on the president's behalf and say Mueller has to be removed for what the White House counsel, Don McGahn,
sentences.zh: 他不会代表总统打电话给司法部说必须撤换穆勒——这是白宫法律顾问唐·麦加恩

sentences.en: thought were some bogus reasons Trump had cooked up about why he didn't like Mueller.
sentences.zh: 认为的特朗普捏造的种种关于他不喜欢穆勒的荒谬理由。

sentences.en: And in the document, as Mueller is recounting what happened in this incident, there are Nixonian echoes.
sentences.zh: 在该文件中，当穆勒在叙述这起事件中发生的事情时，充满了尼克松式的回响。

sentences.en: It says on June 17, 2017,
sentences.zh: 报告称，在2017年6月17日，

sentences.en: the president called McGahn at home and directed him to call the acting attorney general and say that the special counsel had conflicts of interest and must be removed.
sentences.zh: 总统给家里的麦加恩打电话，指示他给代理总检察长打电话，说特别检察官存在利益冲突，必须被撤换。

sentences.en: McGahn did not carry out the direction, however, deciding that he would resign rather than trigger what he regarded as a potential Saturday night massacre,
sentences.zh: 然而，麦加恩没有执行这项指示，他决定宁可辞职，也不愿触发他所认为的潜在的“周六之夜大屠杀”，

sentences.en: a reference to when Richard Nixon fired the special counsel who was investigating him.
sentences.zh: 这是指理查德·尼克松解雇了调查他的特别检察官的那段历史。

sentences.en: I recognize that this question is a little bit meta, but if getting rid of Mueller had meant that the report was never completed,
sentences.zh: 我承认这个问题有点元认知，但如果摆脱穆勒意味着报告永远无法完成，

sentences.en: wouldn't that have finally been obstruction of justice because literally an investigation was obstructed?
sentences.zh: 那难道最终不就成了妨碍司法公正吗，因为字面意义上的调查被妨碍了？

sentences.en: There does seem to be a determination here about the success of the president's efforts or lack of success.
sentences.zh: 这里似乎确实对总统努力的成功与否或缺乏成功做出了某种裁决。

sentences.en: That the fact that the Mueller investigation continued and finished means there is less of a case that the president obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 穆勒调查得以继续并完成这一事实，意味着总统妨碍司法公正的论据变弱了。

sentences.en: If there had been more of a Nixonian moment where there was a 18 minute gap in tapes that were deliberately erased,
sentences.zh: 如果当时发生了更多类似尼克松时期的时刻，比如故意抹去的磁带上有18分钟的空白，

sentences.en: that there was some tangible thing that had happened that had meant that prosecutors couldn't get to the truth,
sentences.zh: 如果发生了某种切实的事情，导致检察官无法触及真相，

sentences.en: there might possibly have been a different judgment or a different outcome.
sentences.zh: 可能会有不同的判断或不同的结果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I keep thinking of that 18 minute deletion when I think about Don McGahn.
sentences.zh: 当我想到唐·麦加恩时，我脑海里总是挥之不去那段18分钟的删除记录。

sentences.en: It's as if nobody had ever said to Nixon what Don McGahn had said to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这就像从来没有人对尼克松说过唐·麦加恩对特朗普总统说的那样。

sentences.en: No, I'm not going to delete that tape.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会删除那段磁带。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: But that's what Don McGahn did to the president.
sentences.zh: 但唐·麦加恩就是这样对总统说的。

sentences.en: That's what happened with Trump over and over again.
sentences.zh: 特朗普身边一次又一次发生的正是这种情况。

sentences.en: Because everyone has seen all the president's men and they know what happens.
sentences.zh: 因为每个人都看过《总统班底》，他们知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And, you know, you don't want to be the guy who carries out the Saturday night massacre.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你可不想成为那个执行“周六之夜大屠杀”的人。

sentences.en: So the president really has these people around him to thank in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面，总统确实要感谢他身边的这些人。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, there were these folks that were not going to go that extra inch and go over the line for him.
sentences.zh: 说到底，正是这些人没有再多迈出那一英寸去为他跨过红线。

sentences.en: And it looks like those measures probably saved him.
sentences.zh: 看来这些措施可能拯救了他。

sentences.en: I mean, Mueller lays this point out explicitly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，穆勒明确指出了这一点。

sentences.en: This is a quote from the report.
sentences.zh: 这是报告中的原话。

sentences.en: The president's efforts to influence the investigation were mostly unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 总统影响调查的努力大多没有成功。

sentences.en: But that is largely because the persons who surrounded the president declined to carry out orders or accede to his requests.
sentences.zh: 但这主要是因为环绕在总统身边的那些人拒绝执行命令或同意他的请求。

sentences.en: Comey did not end the investigation of Flynn, which ultimately resulted in Flynn's prosecution and conviction for lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 科米没有结束对弗林的调查，这最终导致弗林因对联邦调查局撒谎而被起诉和定罪。

sentences.en: McGahn did not tell the acting attorney general that the special counsel must be removed, but was instead prepared to resign over the president's order.
sentences.zh: 麦加恩没有告诉代理总检察长必须撤换特别检察官，而是准备为总统的命令而辞职。

sentences.en: Lewandowski and Dearborn did not deliver the president's message to Sessions that he should confine the Russian investigation to future election meddling only.
sentences.zh: 莱万多夫斯基和迪尔伯恩没有将总统的信息传达给塞申斯，即他应将俄罗斯的调查仅限于未来的选举干预。

sentences.en: And McGahn refused to recede from his recollections about events surrounding the president's direction to have the special counsel removed,
sentences.zh: 麦加恩拒绝收回他对围绕总统指示撤换特别检察官这一事件的回忆，

sentences.en: despite the president's multiple demands to do so.
sentences.zh: 尽管总统多次要求他这么做。

sentences.en: And, Mike, before seeing this report, our understanding of why Mueller may not have reached a conclusion on obstruction of justice was that obstruction has a lot to do with intent.
sentences.zh: 而且，迈克，在看到这份报告之前，我们对穆勒为什么没有对妨碍司法公正得出结论的理解是，妨碍司法与意图有很大关系。

sentences.en: Why did the president take the actions that he took?
sentences.zh: 为什么总统会采取他所采取的行动？

sentences.en: What did we learn from the report about how Mueller might have been thinking about that?
sentences.zh: 我们从报告中了解到穆勒可能如何思考这一问题？

sentences.en: We learned that the president was intent on ending the investigation into himself, but it's less clear about what was truly motivating him.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到总统铁了心要结束针对他自己的调查，但关于究竟是什么在真正驱动他，则没那么清晰。

sentences.en: I guess I don't quite understand that.
sentences.zh: 我想我不太明白这一点。

sentences.en: If his intent is to end the investigation, how is that not obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 如果他的意图是结束调查，这怎么能不算妨碍司法公正呢？

sentences.en: This is the heart of this dispute right now.
sentences.zh: 这正是目前这场争议的核心所在。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The intent to end the investigation to preserve his presidency does, in fact, approach something that is a criminal obstruction of justice,
sentences.zh: 为了维护总统职位而试图结束调查的意图，实际上确实接近了某种刑事妨碍司法公正的行为，

sentences.en: even if they did not make that determination.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们并没有做出那样的定性。

sentences.en: The rub here is that it is at odds with the theory of Robert Mueller's boss, the Attorney General Barr.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这与罗伯特·穆勒的上司、司法部长巴尔的理论相悖。

sentences.en: You got the job of attorney general, some say, based on his theory that the president can't really obstruct justice.
sentences.zh: 有人说，你当上司法部长，正是基于他认为总统实际上无法妨碍司法公正的理论。

sentences.en: Barr says today in his press conference,
sentences.zh: 巴尔在今天的记者会上说，

sentences.en: President Trump faced an unprecedented situation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统面临着前所未有的局面。

sentences.en: As he entered into office and sought to perform his responsibilities as president, federal agents and prosecutors were scrutinizing his conduct before and after taking office.
sentences.zh: 当他入职并试图履行总统职责时，联邦特工和检察官正在仔细审查他在上任前后的行为。

sentences.en: At the heart of a obstruction of justice investigation is whether that person has corrupt intent.
sentences.zh: 妨碍司法公正调查的核心在于此人是否具有腐败意图。

sentences.en: And his determination is that the president did.
sentences.zh: 而他的判定是，总统确实有。

sentences.en: And in a way, this big debate over the intent of the president, Barr kind of goes out of his way today to fill in the blanks, to sort of say, well,
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，对于总统意图的这场大辩论，巴尔今天特意去填补了空白，可以说，嗯，

sentences.en: let's look at the president's intent.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看总统的意图。

sentences.en: At the same time, there was relentless speculation in the news media about the president's personal culpability.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，新闻媒体对总统个人罪责的猜测从未间断。

sentences.en: Yet, as he said from the beginning, there was, in fact, no collusion.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如他从一开始所说的那样，事实上根本没有勾结。

sentences.en: The president felt that this was consuming his presidency.
sentences.zh: 总统觉得这正在吞噬他的总统任期。

sentences.en: There is substantial evidence to show that the president was frustrated and angered by his sincere belief that the investigation was undermining his presidency,
sentences.zh: 有大量证据表明，总统感到沮丧和愤怒，因为他真诚地相信这项调查正在破坏他的总统任期，

sentences.en: propelled by his political opponents and fueled by illegal leaks.
sentences.zh: 在政治对手的推动和非法泄密的推波助澜下。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, the White House fully cooperated with the special counsel's investigation.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，白宫还是全力配合了特别检察官的调查。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He wanted this thing over.
sentences.zh: 他希望这一切早点结束。

sentences.en: So in a way,
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，

sentences.en: what was one of the things that was so extraordinary about Barr's press conference was that he explains the president's reasoning in a way that the president hasn't himself.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的记者会之所以如此非同寻常，原因之一在于他以总统自己没有的方式解释了总统的推理。

sentences.en: So Barr would say that trying to end the investigation to protect the presidency is not corrupt motive.
sentences.zh: 因此巴尔会说，试图结束调查以保护总统职位并不是腐败动机。

sentences.en: In fact, in his telling, it's arguably even important, maybe even a little bit noble.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在他的讲述中，这可以说是很重要的，甚至可能还有点高尚。

sentences.en: It's in the best interest of the American people.
sentences.zh: 这符合美国人民的最大利益。

sentences.en: Perhaps patriotic.
sentences.zh: 也许是出于爱国主义。

sentences.en: So there's this totally compelling moment in the middle of the report that paints a scene of the president being told that a special counsel had just been appointed.
sentences.zh: 所以在报告中间有一个非常引人注目的时刻，描绘了这样一幕：有人告诉总统，刚刚任命了一位特别检察官。

sentences.en: And I'll quote directly from the report.
sentences.zh: 我直接引用报告中的原话。

sentences.en: The president slumped back in his chair and said, oh, my God, this is terrible.
sentences.zh: 总统瘫坐在椅子上说，哦，天哪，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: This is the end of my presidency.
sentences.zh: 这是我总统生涯的终结。

sentences.en: I'm fucked.
sentences.zh: 我完蛋了。

sentences.en: The president became angry and lambasted the attorney general for his decision to recuse from the investigation, stating, how could you let this happen, Jeff?
sentences.zh: 总统勃然大怒，痛斥司法部长决定回避调查，并质问：杰夫，你怎么能让这种事发生？

sentences.en: The president said the position of attorney general was his most important appointment and that Sessions had, quote, let him down,
sentences.zh: 总统说司法部长职位是他最重要的任命，并称塞申斯引述原话“让他失望了”，

sentences.en: contrasting him with Eric Holder and Robert Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 将他与埃里克·霍尔德和罗伯特·肯尼迪进行了对比。

sentences.en: Sessions recalled that the president said to him, you were supposed to protect me or words to that effect.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯回忆说，总统对他说，你本该保护我，或是类似的话。

sentences.en: The president returned to the consequences of the appointment and said, everyone tells me if you get one of these independent counsels, it ruins your presidency.
sentences.zh: 总统再次谈到这项任命的后果并说，每个人都告诉我说，如果弄来一个这样的独立检察官，你的总统任期就毁了。

sentences.en: It takes years and years and I won't be able to do anything.
sentences.zh: 这需要耗费数年又数年，我什么也做不了。

sentences.en: This is the worst thing that ever happened to me.
sentences.zh: 这是我经历过的最糟糕的事。

sentences.en: The way this passage reads is the president's anger about the appointment of a special counsel comes mostly from the recognition that it's going to imperil his presidency.
sentences.zh: 这段话读起来的意思是，总统对任命特别检察官的愤怒主要来自于意识到这会危及他的总统任期。

sentences.en: It means nothing will get done.
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么也做不成。

sentences.en: It means that he's going to spend the rest of his term fighting it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他将在余下的任期里疲于应对。

sentences.en: It's not because he's worried that Robert Mueller might find something that will, you know, one day land Donald Trump in jail.
sentences.zh: 这并不是因为他担心罗伯特·穆勒可能会发现某些东西，你知道的，有一天会把唐纳德·特朗普送进监狱。

sentences.en: That's one reading of this passage that would bolster the argument made by the attorney general that the president faced this extraordinary situation.
sentences.zh: 这是对这段话的一种解读，这种解读会支持司法部长提出的观点，即总统面临着这种非同寻常的处境。

sentences.en: I don't think that makes any sense or at least I don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这根本讲不通，或者说我无法理解。

sentences.en: I don't understand how the attorney general can say there's no issue of an underlying crime here when Donald Trump is sitting there acknowledging the potential threat from the depth and breadth of a special counsel's investigation.
sentences.zh: 我不明白司法部长怎么能说这里不存在潜在犯罪的问题，而唐纳德·特朗普却坐在那里承认特别检察官调查的深度和广度带来的潜在威胁。

sentences.en: He knew at that point in May of 2017 that he had had his personal lawyer, Michael Cohen, make hush money payments to women.
sentences.zh: 他在2017年5月那个时候就知道，他曾让自己的私人律师迈克尔·科恩向女性支付封口费。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was smart enough to know that a special counsel like in Bill Clinton or any other presidency rummages around on one issue and ends up on another.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普足够聪明，知道像比尔·克林顿时期或任何其他总统任期那样的特别检察官，会在一个问题上四处搜寻，结果却牵出另一个问题。

sentences.en: And what happens Mueller finds these weird transactions?
sentences.zh: 如果穆勒发现了这些奇怪的交易会怎么样？

sentences.en: He refers it to another U.S.
sentences.zh: 他将其移交给另一个美国

sentences.en: attorney's office and the president is ultimately in a completely separate investigation named as an unindicted co-conspirator.
sentences.zh: 检察官办公室，最终这位总统在一项完全独立的调查中被列为未被起诉的同谋。

sentences.en: How is there not an underlying crime that Donald Trump was afraid about?
sentences.zh: 怎么会不存在唐纳德·特朗普所恐惧的潜在犯罪呢？

sentences.en: In July of 2017, myself and two colleagues go into the Oval Office to interview the president.
sentences.zh: 2017年7月，我和两位同事走进椭圆形办公室采访总统。

sentences.en: He says, if Mueller looks at my finances, it's crossing a red line.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果穆勒查我的财务状况，这就触碰了红线。

sentences.en: So what were Trump's motivations for getting rid of Mueller?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普摆脱穆勒的动机是什么？

sentences.en: Was he really worried about Russia or was he worried that, hey, if this guy rummages around on Russia, he's going to find something else?
sentences.zh: 他真的是在担心俄罗斯，还是在担心，嘿，如果这家伙在俄罗斯问题上四处搜寻，他会发现别的东西？

sentences.en: Indeed, he did.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他确实发现了。

sentences.en: So, Mike,
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克，

sentences.en: you're saying that Barr's argument that the president is just protecting the presidency doesn't really hold up because we know for a fact that the president understood it.
sentences.zh: 你是说巴尔的观点——即总统只是在保护总统职位——根本站不住脚，因为我们千真万确地知道总统心里很清楚。

sentences.en: At this point, that when he says, I'm effed, that he has these payments made in coordination with Michael Cohen to these women as hush money,
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，当他说我完蛋了的时候，他与迈克尔·科恩协调向这些女性支付了封口费，

sentences.en: which have nothing to do with the Russia investigation, but which obviously could be incredibly damaging to him and maybe even criminal.
sentences.zh: 这与俄罗斯调查毫无关系，但显然可能对他造成极大的破坏，甚至可能是犯罪。

sentences.en: Look, no one has questioned the president about this in a law enforcement setting.
sentences.zh: 听着，在执法环境中没有人就此质问过总统。

sentences.en: I don't know exactly what the president's intentions were,
sentences.zh: 我不知道总统的具体意图是什么，

sentences.en: but the idea that there was no underlying criminality in Donald Trump's life in May of 2017 when Mueller got appointed is bogus because there was.
sentences.zh: 但在2017年5月穆勒被任命时，唐纳德·特朗普的生活中不存在任何潜在犯罪的说法是荒谬的，因为确实存在。

sentences.en: Further, in December of 2017, there's a report out there that Mueller has subpoenaed the president's bank records.
sentences.zh: 此外，在2017年12月，有报道称穆勒已经传唤了总统的银行记录。

sentences.en: Before the president's lawyers are able to get the message to him that the report is wrong, he starts telling White House aides that Mueller has to go.
sentences.zh: 在总统的律师们能够将这篇报道是错误的这一消息传达给他之前，他就开始对白宫助手说穆勒必须走人。

sentences.en: I do think there's a decent case to be made that there were underlying issues of criminality within his life.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为有充分的理由证明他的生活中存在潜在的犯罪问题。

sentences.en: The Justice Department has said that itself.
sentences.zh: 司法部自己也这么说过。

sentences.en: OK, so regardless of the president's intent,
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以不管总统的意图如何，

sentences.en: is it important whether or not he was successful in impeding this investigation in thinking about the question of obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 在思考妨碍司法公正的问题时，他阻碍这项调查是否成功重要吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think for the folks at the Justice Department who had to make the call about whether the president broke the law,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为对于司法部那些必须就是否判定总统触犯法律做出抉择的人来说，

sentences.en: one of the factors that played into their declination decision was the fact that when you looked at the investigation,
sentences.zh: 他们决定不予起诉的因素之一是，当你审视这项调查时，

sentences.en: the efforts that the president took did not significantly damage the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 总统采取的行动并没有对调查造成重大损害。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Despite the president's best efforts, he was not very good at obstructing justice.
sentences.zh: 尽管总统竭尽全力，他在妨碍司法公正方面却很不擅长。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The existence of the Mueller report today suggests that the investigation did not get obstructed.
sentences.zh: 今天穆勒报告的存在表明调查并没有受到阻碍。

sentences.en: Despite all of Donald Trump's huffing and puffing and trying to get this person to do this and this person to do that, Bob Mueller moved ahead unimpeded for two years,
sentences.zh: 尽管唐纳德·特朗普大发雷霆、软硬兼施试图让这个人这样做、让那个人那样做，但鲍勃·穆勒还是畅通无阻地推进了两年，

sentences.en: finished his investigation, and the entire country got to see the fruits of it.
sentences.zh: 完成了他的调查，整个国家都看到了调查成果。

sentences.en: And show us where the obstruction is, is what the president's defenders would say.
sentences.zh: 总统的辩护者会说，那你们倒是指出妨碍司法的地方在哪啊。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So finally, I want to talk about Bill Barr's role in all this, because the position of many Democrats today was that Barr,
sentences.zh: 所以最后，我想谈谈比尔·巴尔在这其中的角色，因为今天许多民主党人的立场是，巴尔

sentences.en: in reaching a decision on obstruction of justice where Mueller did not, in holding a press conference ahead of the report's release, seeming to defend the president,
sentences.zh: 在穆勒没有做出裁决的情况下就妨碍司法公正做出决定，在报告发布前举行记者会，似乎在为总统辩护，

sentences.en: all taken together, has undermined any credibility that he had.
sentences.zh: 所有这些加在一起，已经损害了他原本拥有的任何公信力。

sentences.en: And that Democrats and the country need to see for themselves what Mueller had found.
sentences.zh: 并且民主党人和全国人民需要亲自去看看穆勒发现了什么。

sentences.en: How are you thinking about Barr in this moment, having now spent time with the Mueller report?
sentences.zh: 既然现在已经花时间阅读了穆勒报告，你此刻如何看待巴尔？

sentences.en: I mean, the one thing is clear is that, you know, this has been a lot of red meat for Democrats in Congress to keep investigating.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一点很清楚，你知道的，这对国会中的民主党人来说是一块大肥肉，让他们能够继续调查。

sentences.en: And one of the things that they're going to keep investigating is Barr's role in this entire process.
sentences.zh: 他们将继续调查的事情之一就是巴尔在整个过程中的角色。

sentences.en: They are going to try to get him up to testify.
sentences.zh: 他们会试图让他出席作证。

sentences.en: They are going to try to get more underlying documents in the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们会试图获取穆勒调查中更多的基础文件。

sentences.en: They now see Barr as a clear target for them.
sentences.zh: 他们现在将巴尔视为一个明确的目标。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people, because of all these actions, have a much different picture of the attorney general than they did a month or two ago.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多人由于所有这些行动，对司法部长的看法与一两个月前大不相同。

sentences.en: And they're going to try to understand the differences between what Bob Mueller thinks about all this, the supposedly nonpartisan figure, and what Bill Barr thinks about this,
sentences.zh: 他们将试图弄清鲍勃·穆勒（这个所谓的无党派人物）对这一切的看法与比尔·巴尔（这个效忠对象明显更倾向于总统的总统任命官员）的看法之间有什么不同。

sentences.en: the presidential appointee whose allegiances are clearly closer to the president.
sentences.zh: 这些人会试图理解这种差异。

sentences.en: There's one answer to this, and that is that after this entire investigation in which Bob Mueller has said nothing publicly, including today,
sentences.zh: 对此只有一个答案，那就是在经历了这场鲍勃·穆勒没有公开说过任何话的完整调查之后，包括今天

sentences.en: when there was a press conference held to talk about his report, we need to hear from Bob Mueller.
sentences.zh: 在举行记者会讨论他的报告时，我们需要听到鲍勃·穆勒的声音。

sentences.en: We need for him to explain to us more how they came to this determination, that they couldn't say whether the president violated the law or not.
sentences.zh: 我们需要他向我们更多地解释他们是如何得出这个结论的——即他们无法说明总统是否违法。

sentences.en: Does Mueller think that Barr has misrepresented some of his findings?
sentences.zh: 穆勒是否认为巴尔歪曲了他的一些调查结果？

sentences.en: What was his relationship with the Justice Department?
sentences.zh: 他与司法部的关系如何？

sentences.en: Did he believe that Congress should deal with this issue and that Barr shouldn't have made a call on whether the president violated the law?
sentences.zh: 他是否认为国会应该处理这个问题，而巴尔不应对总统是否违法做出判断？

sentences.en: We need to hear from Mueller.
sentences.zh: 我们需要听到穆勒的声音。

sentences.en: We have never heard his voice in the past two years.
sentences.zh: 在过去的两年里，我们从来没有听到过他的声音。

sentences.en: So inadvertently, in seeming to protect the president and not be representing Mueller,
sentences.zh: 因此，比尔·巴尔在看似保护总统而不是代表穆勒的过程中，无意中

sentences.en: Bill Barr may be extending Democrats' interest in this investigation and the trouble for the president.
sentences.zh: 可能延长了民主党人对这项调查的兴趣，并给总统带来了更多麻烦。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: If you look back at what Barr has done in the last month,
sentences.zh: 如果你回想一下巴尔过去一个月所做的事情，

sentences.en: this could have turned out differently for him if he had put out the report immediately after the letter or soon after the letter as he could have,
sentences.zh: 如果他在信件发布后立即或在信件发布后不久尽可能快地公开发布报告，事情对他的结果可能会有所不同，

sentences.en: if he had characterized the report differently in that four-page letter,
sentences.zh: 如果他在那封四页的信中对报告的定性有所不同，

sentences.en: and if he hadn't had a press conference on the day of the release before anyone had seen the report that had this appearance of trying to spin it for the president and protect the president.
sentences.zh: 以及如果他在报告发布的当天、在任何人看到报告之前没有举行那场看起来像是在为总统开脱和保护总统的记者会的话。

sentences.en: That seems to have created more problems, both for Barr and the president, than if they had just released the report.
sentences.zh: 这似乎给巴尔和总统带来的麻烦，比他们直接发布报告要多得多。

sentences.en: Merck, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 默克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我们。
